text.arabic_uthmani: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ

words.gloss_range: coordinating and resumptive connector that opens another sign-catalogue entry
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) makes the ayah continue the sign catalogue around 51:37, 51:38, 51:41, and 51:43 while also opening a new punished-people panel. Its force is not just additive: it helps form the compact and-in formula where the sign-predicate is supplied from the surrounding sequence, and its brief sound launches directly into the next prepositional frame.

topics.headline: catalogue resumption with a new scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the Aad panel as accumulated evidence in a continuing sign series, not as an isolated notice.
topics.reason: The connector is licensed as coordination with the preceding narrative and as the repeated entry device of the sign catalogue, including the sequence around 51:37, 51:38, 51:41, and 51:43.

topics.headline: compact sign formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader supplies the omitted sign-predicate and notices that a tiny opening formula carries a full evidentiary claim.
topics.reason: The row family treats the opening formula as elliptical rather than as bare narration, and the bundle supports a repeated locus-exemplum frame.

topics.headline: short audible launch unit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can notice that the connector and following preposition are heard as a compact entry signal before the people-name appears.
topics.reason: The phonetic point is local and modest: it supports the perceived compactness of the entry frame without creating a separate lexical sense.

words.gloss_range: prepositional containment, locally used for a thematic sign-domain rather than mere physical location
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) makes Aad the domain in which the sign is found, not simply a place on a map. The preposition carries the elided predication of the sign formula, repeats the catalogue container used for the Moses and Thamud panels at 51:38 and 51:43, and then yields to the verbal punishment scene that explains the sign.

topics.headline: thematic containment, not bare location
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the people-name as an evidence-container, while the ordinary spatial force is narrowed into narrative containment.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the genitive proper noun, but the repeated sign frame and ellipsis select thematic containment rather than a simple physical location.

topics.headline: preposition carries omitted sign claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how much predicative work is compressed into the preposition because the sign itself is not restated.
topics.reason: The compact opening depends on the prior sign frame, so the preposition functions as the carrier of an elided evidence claim.

topics.headline: repeated container across panels
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same prepositional frame comparing Moses, Aad, and Thamud while each following clause differentiates the case.
topics.reason: The rows point to a repeated catalogue construction and to the boundary shift from the physical sea in 51:40 to narrative containment in 51:41.

topics.headline: frame before event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah first labels the location of evidence and only afterward narrates the act of punishment.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase precedes the temporal verbal clause, making the opening beat a frame rather than the destruction event itself.

words.gloss_range: proper name of the people Aad, governed as a genitive sign-domain and resumed by a plural target pronoun
words.root_gloss_range: return, recurrence, restoration, and place of return in the broader root family; here these are only secondary pressure on a proper name
words.prose: {{ar:عَادٍ}} ({{tr:ʿĀdin}}) is a governed, fully declined proper name, so Aad is placed inside the sign-frame before the event begins rather than made the sender or agent. Its singular name can carry the whole punished collective resumed later by a plural pronoun, and its familiar destruction dossier (7:65, 11:50, 26:123, 41:15, 54:18, 69:6) lets the ayah compress the story into one name and the wind-instrument. The {{ar:ع و د}} ({{tr:ʿ-w-d}}) root family can add recurrence and return pressure, but locally the word remains the people-name, not a translated etymology.

topics.headline: genitive proper name as collective domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Aad as the sign-domain and collective target, not as the grammatical agent of the sending.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive after the preposition and supplies the antecedent for the later third-person plural suffix, so one proper name carries a community.

topics.headline: declined name inside Arabic case syntax
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the old people-name is not frozen outside the syntax; it is integrated into the prepositional frame by case and tanwin.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the form as genitive and indefinite in form, and the rows rightly preserve the triptote morphology as a local grammatical payoff.

topics.headline: compressed destroyed-nation memory
topics.reader_payoff: The reader imports the known Aad punishment memory from passages such as 7:65, 11:50, 26:123, 41:15, 54:18, and 69:6 without requiring the full narrative here.
topics.reason: The proper noun has enough distributional familiarity as a destroyed-people name to support compression, and the cited passages make the echo concrete.

topics.headline: return etymology kept secondary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader may sense recurrence and return pressure in the root family, while the local reading remains the proper name Aad.
topics.reason: The etymological rows are meaningful for lexical review, but QAC and local syntax treat the word as a proper noun; the root field colors the warning rather than replacing the name.

topics.headline: people-name beat pivots to explanation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah move in stages: sign-domain, explanatory time-frame, then dispatch and instrument.
topics.reason: The fronted prepositional proper name completes the opening beat and is immediately followed by the temporal hinge that explains the sign.

words.gloss_range: temporal adverb that opens the completed verbal scene and explains the sign-domain
words.prose: {{ar:إِذْ}} ({{tr:idh}}) turns the preceding sign-domain into a specific event: the sign in Aad is displayed when the sending happened. It is temporal and explanatory at once, governing the completed verbal clause and serving as the hinge between the people-name and the punishment action; the same hinge pattern also prepares the neighboring punished-people entry at 51:43.

topics.headline: when as sign-specifier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands the time marker as the device that tells what the sign in Aad consists of.
topics.reason: The temporal adverb is syntactically forced with the following verbal clause, and the ellipsis of the sign frame gives it explanatory force.

topics.headline: retrospective completed event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the wind-sending as a closed historical case offered for reflection, not as an open-ended threat.
topics.reason: The following perfect verb fills the adverbial slot, so the time-frame is retrospective and completed.

topics.headline: scene-cut inside repeated architecture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the catalogue changes scenes by repeating a hinge: name the people, then name the moment that reveals the sign.
topics.reason: The temporal hinge converts the nominal sign-container into action and echoes the same people-entry architecture in 51:43.

topics.headline: middle architecture of the ayah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the divine dispatch clause as the ayah's middle event-frame between sign-domain and final wind description.
topics.reason: The particle opens the clause that structurally occupies the middle beat of the ayah.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect first-person plural dispatch: We sent, caused to go forth, or deployed a payload toward a target
words.root_gloss_range: sending, dispatch, release, mission, and messenger language; locally narrowed to directed punitive dispatch of a wind
words.prose: {{ar:أَرْسَلْنَا}} ({{tr:arsalnā}}) centers the ayah on a completed divine act: the subject is fused into the verb, and the perfect form presents the event as an accomplished case. The {{ar:ر س ل}} ({{tr:r-s-l}}) root can carry mission and release language, but the Form IV causative frame, the target phrase, and the wind payload narrow it into deliberate punitive dispatch rather than a free storm. That makes the verb a pivot from sign-frame to action, and it also echoes nearby sending scenes at 51:31 and 51:38 while the shift from towardness to pressure marks the punishment specialization.

topics.headline: completed act with fused divine subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the wind-sending as an accomplished divine action compressed into the verb itself.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify a Form IV perfect first-person plural verb with an implicit divine subject supplied by agreement.

topics.headline: release image narrowed to caused dispatch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the wind as a payload made to go forth against a target, not as autonomous weather.
topics.reason: The root's release image survives because the payload is wind, while Form IV transitivity and the explicit object-plus-target frame narrow the sense to caused dispatch.

topics.headline: mission language weaponized
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a root often used for messengers and missions is here repurposed to send a destructive natural force.
topics.reason: The broader mission field is real, but the local object and target preposition prevent a guidance-sending reading; the payoff is contrast, especially with 51:38 and 51:31.

topics.headline: known retributive sending frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the clause as part of a punishment-dispatch formula, while this ayah specifies wind and barrenness as its payload and effect.
topics.reason: The phrase family has concrete punishment parallels such as 7:133, 17:68, and 54:34, and the local frame fits that retributive pattern.

topics.headline: verb pivots frame into action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah shift from evidentiary framing into kinetic divine action at this verb.
topics.reason: The verb occupies the middle event position after the sign-domain and before target, object, and final qualifier unfold.

topics.headline: nearby dispatch echoes with changed direction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same sending root links nearby scenes, but preposition and payload shift the effect from mission toward punishment.
topics.reason: The rows identify local echoes with 51:31 and 51:38; the local target phrase marks the punitive specialization.

topics.headline: sound releases into target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the verb as movement into the target phrase while the catalogue reuses divine-agent grammar for a new punished collective.
topics.reason: The phonetic and boundary rows add a modest local payoff: the action feels outward-moving and structurally parallel without making the targets co-referential.

words.gloss_range: preposition upon or against plus third-person masculine plural suffix, marking Aad as the affected target
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْهِمُ}} ({{tr:ʿalayhimu}}) compresses hostile direction and the affected group into one bound target phrase. The suffix resumes Aad as a collective, while the preposition gives the dispatch a bearing-down, against-them orientation rather than a neutral destination; its position before the wind makes targethood visible before the payload is named. The final liaison vowel also smooths the recitation into the instrument, keeping target and wind tightly connected.

topics.headline: plural suffix resumes Aad
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the singular people-name into a plural affected group without confusing this target with earlier punished groups.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence resolves the suffix to the nearby collective proper noun while warning that the repeated plural pattern is structural, not co-reference with 51:40.

topics.headline: upon becomes against
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the wind imposed down upon Aad, not merely sent in their direction.
topics.reason: The preposition is syntactically tied to the dispatch verb and semantically marks hostile superposition and affected targethood.

topics.headline: affected target separated from payload
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees who bears the punishment before learning what instrument is sent.
topics.reason: The target phrase precedes the direct object, making the affected group a bridge between divine sending and the wind payload.

topics.headline: bound target unit smooths into instrument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear relation and referent bound together, with the liaison vowel carrying the phrase directly into the wind.
topics.reason: The liaison detail is phonological rather than morphological, but it has a local payoff in keeping target and instrument audibly connected.

topics.headline: towardness contrasted with hostile pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how nearby sending scenes can turn from approach to punishment by changing the preposition and payload.
topics.reason: The contrast with 51:31 and the hostile targeting echo at 51:33 are concrete local comparisons, while the current phrase remains the governing target marker.

words.gloss_range: the definite singular wind as accusative payload of divine dispatch, locally destructive and qualified by barrenness
words.root_gloss_range: wind, breath, spirit, movement, relief, and mercy in the broad family; here narrowed to the concrete wind instrument with life-breath tension
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلرِّيحَ}} ({{tr:al-rīḥa}}) is the direct object, the payload sent upon Aad, not a background weather condition. Its definiteness assumes the known Aad punishment-wind dossier (41:16, 46:24, 54:19, 69:6), its singular form concentrates the force against plural mercy-wind patterns (7:57, 15:22, 30:46), and the following adjective locks barrenness onto the wind itself. The {{ar:ر و ح}} ({{tr:r-w-ḥ}}) family can evoke breath, spirit, relief, and movement, so the local phrase creates a sharp reversal: an invisible life-like force becomes a sterile instrument that continues into the destruction described in 51:42.

topics.headline: known wind as sent object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the wind as the identifiable payload of divine dispatch, not as scenery around the punishment.
topics.reason: The word is accusative as the explicit object of the sending verb, and the article makes it a known wind within the compressed Aad memory.

topics.headline: singular wind concentrates punishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the singular wind form concentrates a focused destructive force rather than distributing mercy-bearing winds.
topics.reason: The singular-punishment versus plural-mercy pattern is useful but should not become an absolute rule; locally it is reinforced by the target phrase and barren adjective.

topics.headline: life-breath family turned sterile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the irony that a root family associated with breath, spirit, and relief is here specified as a barren destructive force.
topics.reason: The broad root field is real, but the local noun means wind; the life-side functions as semantic tension once the adjective seals it as barren.

topics.headline: wind hands the ayah to barren qualifier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the noun introduce the instrument and then transfer attention to the final quality that defines it.
topics.reason: Agreement forces the final adjective to qualify the wind, and the local order makes the adjective a delayed interpretive reveal.

topics.headline: Aad wind memory with distinctive qualifier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader imports the Aad wind dossier from 41:16, 46:24, 54:19, and 69:6 while noticing that 51:41 selects barrenness as its lens.
topics.reason: The cross-passage evidence is concrete and supports contrast among qualifiers without overriding the local adjective.

topics.headline: wind as dispatched agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the natural force as an instrument under divine sending rather than an autonomous agent.
topics.reason: The local verb-object frame realizes a broader sending-wind association while keeping divine agency primary.

topics.headline: object becomes next ayah's destructive subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the wind from named payload in 51:41 into the destroying agent whose effect is described in 51:42.
topics.reason: The next ayah unfolds what the introduced wind does, so the object role here anticipates continuing agency in 51:42.

topics.headline: breath-like and forceful sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear breath-like texture and a forceful definite onset that fit the wind's entrance after the target phrase.
topics.reason: The sound-shape rows remain local phonetic payoffs: assimilation, long vowel, final breath consonant, and gemination support how the wind is heard.

topics.headline: concrete wind within broad root family
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the concrete wind usage as marked within a wider family of spirit, relief, and movement senses.
topics.reason: The local sense is concrete wind, while the wider root family supplies contrast and not alternative translation.

words.gloss_range: definite feminine singular accusative adjective: barren, sterile, non-generative, and locally severing continuity
words.root_gloss_range: barrenness, sterility, obstruction, and cutting off; locally the adjective defines the wind's destructive inability to generate or leave continuation
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَقِيمَ}} ({{tr:al-ʿaqīma}}) is locked to the wind by agreement, so barrenness is the sent payload's own property and not a loose moral comment. The {{ar:ع ق م}} ({{tr:ʿ-q-m}}) field makes the final word more than strong-wind language: it names sterility, no rain, no fertility, and severed continuation as a durable quality. Its rarity, its reversal of Sarah's barrenness in 51:29, its terminal-day edge from 22:55, and its ayah-final position make barrenness the interpretive seal that 51:42 turns into visible decay.

topics.headline: agreement makes barrenness the wind's property
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the adjective grammatically built into the wind phrase, not appended as an independent comment.
topics.reason: The adjective agrees with the wind in definiteness, gender, number, and accusative case, fixing the qualifying relation.

topics.headline: specific destructive attribute
topics.reader_payoff: The reader receives the wind under a definite recognized quality that completes the instrument phrase.
topics.reason: The article and concord make the adjective part of a definite phrase, not an indefinite or generic wind description.

topics.headline: sterility defines the wind's effect
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands the wind as a force that produces no rain, no fertility, and no continuation for what it strikes.
topics.reason: The root field supports barrenness and severance, and the local wind context makes that image active rather than merely descriptive.

topics.headline: qualitative sterility, not momentary act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sterility is presented as the wind's identity at dispatch, not just something the wind happens to do once.
topics.reason: The qualitative adjective pattern is compatible with a stable property, while the local phrase keeps the referent as the wind.

topics.headline: rare barrenness across womb, day, and wind
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the rare root gathering human fertility, terminal time, and meteorology into one non-generation field.
topics.reason: The root has a small occurrence set and the wind collocation is unique here, but the cross-domain range colors the adjective rather than replacing the local wind qualification.

topics.headline: Sarah reversal and barren day edge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that barrenness overcome by birth in 51:29 is reversed here into a wind whose barrenness prevents continuation, with 22:55 adding terminal-day resonance.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah echoes are concrete and useful, but they remain resonance fields; local grammar still makes the adjective qualify the wind in 51:41.

topics.headline: ayah-final interpretive seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader experiences barrenness as the final meaning left after sign-domain, event, target, and wind have been processed.
topics.reason: The terminal adjective combines rarity, grammatical agreement, and final position, making it the closure of the ayah's payload phrase.

topics.headline: force redirected to futurity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader first receives wind as force, then learns at the final word that its defining effect is failed future and visible decay in 51:42.
topics.reason: The local order delays the decisive quality until the end, and the next ayah concretizes barrenness as destructive aftermath.

topics.headline: closed sound and paired adjective boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the closed final texture and the paired adjective movement from moral verdict in 51:40 to barren instrument in 51:41.
topics.reason: The sound rows support constricted closure, and the boundary row gives a concrete comparison between the final adjectives of 51:40 and 51:41.

topics.headline: breath-field plus severance makes anti-generation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final phrase turn invisible movement into the cutting off of future life, a payoff neither wind nor barrenness alone carries as fully.
topics.reason: The unique barren-wind construction lets the wind's life-breath associations and the adjective's severance field converge into an anti-generation mechanism.

baseline_models.mechanism: Aad is the named recipient of a released atmospheric agent whose defining sterility is failure to pollinate or carry rain; its dispatch therefore yields destruction rather than benefit.

activation_trace.role: The proper-name branch fixes Aad as the collective recipient of the dispatch.
Release and sending supply the directed launch of the agent.
Wind and moving air supply the physical carrier.
The rainless, non-pollinating destructive wind supplies failed generativity as its operative quality.

changed_reading.before: A wind was sent against Aad.
changed_reading.after: A deliberately dispatched carrier reaches Aad with inverted yield: it produces destruction precisely by carrying no rain or fertilizing power.

baseline_models.mechanism: The wind shares a root field with breath, life, rest, and vegetative unfolding, while barrenness closes womb, offspring, and bodily articulation. The phrase can therefore stage an anti-breath that reverses opening and renewal into closure.

activation_trace.role: Breath or spirit supplies the life-bearing pole inverted by this wind.
The unfolding of leaves and lengthening of plants supplies the growth normally associated with life-giving air.
Sterility of womb and offspring supplies blocked continuation.
Dried joints and blocked loins turn generative closure into bodily immobilization.

changed_reading.before: The adjective merely says that the wind is infertile.
changed_reading.after: The phrase presents a life-associated medium turned against life, replacing breath, growth, and articulation with closure.

baseline_models.mechanism: Sending can carry a message and proceed in successive units, while barrenness blocks offspring. The construction permits a delivery paradox: arrival succeeds, but nothing beneficial or continuing can issue from it.

activation_trace.role: Messenger and message supply delivery as a possible functional frame for the sent wind.
Successive dispatched units supply serial transmission rather than an undirected gust.
Blocked offspring makes the delivered event terminate continuation instead of founding it.

changed_reading.before: The wind is only a weapon that happens to be sent.
changed_reading.after: The wind is a successful delivery whose content is failed continuation: it arrives in order to leave no generative sequel.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same dispatch field first carries a human messenger with disclosure and later recurs in the formula that every messenger was dismissed as sorcerer or madman. The wind can consequently function as a nonverbal emissary whose arrival embodies the warning that rejected speech did not transmit.

activation_trace.role: The focus dispatch supplies the common action linking wind and envoy.
The physical wind supplies the nonhuman bearer of the enacted warning.
The messenger and message branch, instantiated by the human sending, makes the shared dispatch potentially communicative.
Disclosure by speech or sign supplies the explicit evidentiary function of the earlier mission.
The recurring messenger formula turns the focus dispatch into one position within a repeated warning pattern.
Recasting a message as deceptive diversion supplies one mode of failed verbal reception.
The charge of concealed reason supplies the other repeated strategy for refusing the messenger.
Mutual transmission of the same response makes rejection itself the message that peoples successfully pass onward.

structural_cues: 51:38 and 51:41 repeat the frame وَفِي ... إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا, but the dispatched object changes from a human envoy to wind and the relation changes from إِلَى to hostile عَلَيْهِم.
51:52-53 generalizes the sorcerer-or-madman response across messengers and asks whether successive peoples transmitted it to one another.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel dispatch grammar, manifest disclosure, and repeated rejection; I infer that the wind enacts a warning after verbal reception fails. A live alternative is that the parallel marks only common divine agency, with no communicative role assigned to the wind.

changed_reading.before: The wind is a mute instrument following an unrelated messenger story.
changed_reading.after: The wind becomes an embodied, nonverbal emissary in the same dispatch sequence, making rejected warning physically undeniable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah gives the wind a totalizing encounter rule: it leaves nothing it reaches without making it decayed remains. Barrenness is therefore not passive lack of fertility but active conversion of formed things into nonproductive residue.

activation_trace.role: The wind supplies the mobile agent whose path is elaborated in the next ayah.
The destructive non-pollinating wind supplies the focus quality that the sequel turns into a process.
Leaving or abandoning supplies the negated escape condition: no encountered thing is left intact.
The coming of affliction or destruction makes contact with the wind an arrival of ruin.
Causing a thing to enter a state supplies the transformation from encountered object to residue.
Decay and worn remains supply the terminal material state produced by the wind.

structural_cues: 51:42 refers back with feminine verbs to the wind and uses the exhaustive pattern مَا ... مِن شَيْءٍ ... إِلَّا.
The verbal sequence reaches, makes, and decayed remains converts an adjective in 51:41 into a causal operation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exhaustive scope, encounter, causative change, and decay; I infer the arrow contact leads to irreversible de-formation. The live alternative is that the final comparison describes only visible appearance, not literal material conversion.

changed_reading.before: Barren means the wind simply contributes no rain or growth.
changed_reading.after: Its barrenness is productive in reverse: every successful encounter manufactures decay and removes the capacity for further form.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pericope pivots from ruin to building the sky, widening, spreading the earth, creating, and pairing everything. Within that productive architecture, the barren wind becomes a marked counter-creation: a locally sent process that disjoins and closes where creation joins, expands, and pairs.

activation_trace.role: Air-associated vegetal unfolding supplies the productive possibility denied by this wind.
Blocked offspring supplies the focus-level negation of generative pairing.
Building by joining parts supplies constructive integration opposite the wind's de-formation.
Expansion against constriction supplies the cosmic scale of productive opening.
Spreading and preparing a surface supplies habitable extension rather than stripping to residue.
Bringing creation into existence supplies the positive process inverted by destructive barrenness.
Joining each counterpart to its mate supplies the generative relation that barrenness blocks.

structural_cues: The destruction sequence in 51:41-46 pivots directly into first-person-plural building, spreading, and creating in 51:47-49.
The singular adjective ٱلْعَقِيمَ is followed by the universal paired-creation claim مِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies constructive joining, widening, spreading, creation, and pairing; I infer that their sequence deliberately marks the barren wind as local counter-creation. A live alternative is that 51:47-49 begins an independent proof unit and heightens contrast without directly glossing the wind.

changed_reading.before: The wind is an isolated destructive weather event.
changed_reading.after: The wind is a bounded inversion inside a generative cosmos: it closes pairing and dismantles form under the same agency that builds and expands.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing context denies any divine need for provision or feeding and names God as provider, while the provision inventory includes rain. Strength and firmness then prevent barrenness from reading as incapacity: the rainless wind is a selective withholding and reversal of meteorological provision.

activation_trace.role: The wind that carries no rain supplies the withheld meteorological yield.
Provision as an apportioned gift supplies the category explicitly denied as a divine need.
Feeding another supplies the nutritive transfer that creatures cannot provide to the sender.
Rain descending as provision directly activates the beneficial cargo absent from the barren wind.
Concentrated strength rules out inability as the reason the wind bears no rain.
Extended solidity supplies sustained capacity behind both provision and its withholding.

structural_cues: 51:57-58 place provision and feeding under explicit negation of divine need, then assert provider, strength, and firmness.
The branch equation of rain with provision retrospectively sharpens the focus inventory's definition of the barren wind as rainless.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rain-as-provision, denied divine need, and undiminished strength; I infer that absent rain is chosen withholding rather than failed capacity. A live alternative is that the provider passage governs worship alone and does not retrospectively classify the wind.

changed_reading.before: The wind lacks a useful payload.
changed_reading.after: The sender who owns rain-provision deliberately sends this carrier without it, turning a normal channel of sustenance into discriminating deprivation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates return and counting branches behind a proper name. It remains anchored to عَادٍ and is reinforced by later mutual transmission, likeness, allotted share, and appointed-time language, but downstream prose must preserve Aad as the tribal referent and present recurrence only as secondary root resonance, not etymology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عَادٍ at 51:41 word 2, first resolved by its explicit tribal-name branch.

activation_trace.role: The explicit Aad branch keeps the proper name primary and contains all secondary resonance.
Return after departure supplies a faint recurrence image around the named case.
The split mapped root's counting branch supplies the possibility of Aad as one enumerated instance in a series.
Mutual bequeathing supplies continuity of the same rejection across otherwise separate peoples.
Likeness and counterpart relation make earlier companions a repeatable comparison class.
An allotted share supplies each group's portion within the recurring pattern.
An appointment fixed by time supplies the bounded arrival of each threatened outcome.
The non-dominant counting target's timed recurrence sharpens the serial-allotment resonance.

changed_reading.before: عَادٍ only identifies one destroyed people.
changed_reading.after: Without ceasing to be the proper name, Aad can faintly resonate as one counted recurrence in a serial pattern of transmitted rejection and allotted outcome.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers a branch for opaque, derivationally closed speech to an adjective syntactically modifying wind. It remains anchored to the focus pair of sending and barrenness and to the context's messenger, disclosure, and repeated rejection pattern; downstream prose must label it a functional analogy, never the lexical meaning of ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The construction أَرْسَلْنَا ... ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ links dispatch with the unusual speech branch inside ع ق م.

activation_trace.role: Message-bearing dispatch supplies the communicative side of the analogy.
The literal wind keeps the analogy attached to the actual syntactic noun.
Opaque speech from which no derivation proceeds supplies communicative closure as an exploratory image.
Disclosure through speech or sign supplies the intended openness against which barren communication is measured.
The repeated arrival of messengers supplies the communicative sequence that human audiences close.
Uttered response supplies the verbal channel in which rejection is repeatedly voiced.
Mutual bequeathing shows that rejection reproduces socially even while reception of warning remains closed.

changed_reading.before: The wind is mute punishment outside the discourse of warning.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, it is a final message barren of dialogue and sequel: destructive clarity replaces speech that audiences repeatedly close or distort.

strongest_changes: 51:42 turns absent fertility into active conversion of every encountered thing into decayed remains.
The messenger pattern in 51:38 and 51:52 recasts the wind as an embodied nonverbal dispatch after verbal warning is rejected.
51:47-49 marks the barren wind as counter-creation within a cosmos of joining, expansion, spreading, and pairing.
51:57-58 makes rainlessness selective withholding of provision rather than lack of power.
summary.what_was_special: The strongest activation was the paradox of a medium associated with breath, growth, and message being successfully sent to terminate generation. Split-root echoes around عَادٍ also preserve a tightly contained recurrence reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The messenger analogy may arise from parallel grammar and sequence rather than an intended personification of the wind.
The paired-creation and provision passages may heighten contrast without directly glossing ٱلْعَقِيمَ.
Return and counting resonance in the proper name عَادٍ must remain secondary to its tribal reference.
The barren-speech branch is a functional cross-domain analogy, not a lexical claim about the phrase.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A dispatched wind that cannot transmit life.** `ع و د/B012` anchors the named people ʿĀd; `ر س ل/B001` supplies sending forth; `ر و ح/B003` wind; `ع ق م/B002` a sterile wind that pollinates neither trees nor clouds and may destroy. Against sky-provision in 51:22, I infer **withheld fertility -> moving air becomes anti-provision**. The wind is defined not merely by violence but by failure to carry generative benefit.
2. **Power is reversed against a powerful group.** `ر و ح/B011` supplies force/dominance, while the prior Pharaoh scene has relied-on force and gathered troops. I infer **dominant collective meets a greater released force -> its power fails to reproduce itself**. This political overtone remains beside the ecological sterility reading.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 51:47-49's built sky, prepared earth, and paired creation made the sterile wind read more sharply as an interruption of the surah's normal generative order.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **A sent medium whose only yield is non-yield.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ر س ل/B001` is being sent forth; fixed `ر و ح/B003` is wind and moving air; fixed `ع ق م/B002` is explicitly “sterile wind.” **Structural cue:** a lone safe household and a cast army lie behind (51:36–40); the wind next leaves nothing it reaches except crumbling remains (51:42), followed by expiring respite, thunderbolt, failed rising, and an earlier transgressing people (51:43–46). **Role and abduction:** sending gives the wind a directed mission, motion gives it reach, and sterility blocks productive aftermath; I infer from 51:42 that its negative fertility converts every contact into decay. **Reading change:** the wind is not only destructive weather but an anti-provisioning carrier that spreads inability to continue.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 51:42’s universal conversion into crumbling remains supplied the exact yield of sterility: every contact produces only loss of continuation.

baseline.text: Âd'da da bir işaret vardır; üzerlerine kısır rüzgârı göndermiştik.

findings.text: Kısır rüzgâr, yağmur ve tozlaşma taşımak yerine temas ettiği yerde hayatın sürmesini keserek rızkın tersine işleyen bir taşıyıcı olur.
Güçlü bir topluluğun karşısına daha büyük bir hareket kuvvetinin çıkması, onların egemenliğini kendi devamını üretemeyen bir hâle getirir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P3 (51:38-60): Elemental Unmaking and Lost Capacity
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Released force overtakes a population by progressively removing form, time, stance, and aid.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Wind and thunder do not merely destroy objects; they dismantle the predicates of agency, from remaining intact to standing and receiving help.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Sterile Wind to Residue
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A released but nonproductive wind reaches each thing, abandons it, and converts it into decayed remains.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: release of a natural force (`quranic:root_000563:B001/m02`); wind (`quranic:root_000609:B003/m01`); sterility (`quranic:root_001037:B002/m01`); leaving or abandoning (`quranic:root_001638:B003/m01`); arrival and reaching (`quranic:root_000009:B001/m01`); transformation into a state (`quranic:root_000248:B002/m01`); decayed remains (`quranic:root_000601:B004/m01`); entity or thing (`quranic:root_000831:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 51:41 `أَرْسَلْ` (ر س ل), `رِّيحَ` (ر و ح), `عَقِيمَ` (ع ق م); 51:42 `أَتَتْ` (ء ت ي), `تَذَرُ` (و ذ ر), `جَعَلَتْ` (ج ع ل), `رَّمِيمِ` (ر م م), `شَىْءٍ` (ش ي ء).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Sterility names the wind's output as well as its nature: it produces nothing living and leaves nothing productive. Arrival, abandonment, and transformation form a single operation that converts differentiated things into one residue.

facets.statement: Ayrılınan bir şeye geri gelme ve başlangıçtan sonra aynı işe yeniden yönelme çekirdektir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşuda amaçlı eğitim süreci belirleyicidir; odakta eğitim şart değildir ve kendiliğinden yerleşen alışkanlık da çekirdeğe girer.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki bağlı ziyaret kullanımını destekler: hastayı ziyaret etmek ve bir felaket ya da yas dolayısıyla insanların bir haneye tekrar tekrar gelmesi. Bunlar genel ziyaret değil, dönüş fikriyle sözlüksel olarak sınırlandırılmış yapılardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, her türlü ziyaret veya bakım hizmetini değil, hasta ziyareti ile felaket ya da yas dolayısıyla gidilen özel ziyaret ortamını kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım hasta ziyareti tamlamasını, ziyaretçi adlarını ve yas veya felaket ziyaretini bildiren özel biçimi birbirine karıştırmadan korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir hastayı ziyaret etmek veya bir felaket ya da yas dolayısıyla insanların aynı haneye gidip gelmesi; türemiş adlarda bu ziyaretçiler ya da ziyaret edilen acı olay da anlatılır.

facets.statement: Hastaya giderek onu ziyaret etmek dalın başlıca sözlüksel gerçekleşmesidir.
Hasta ziyaretini yapan erkek ve kadın toplulukları ayrı ad biçimleriyle gösterilir.
Bir felaket veya yas sebebiyle insanların uğradığı hane ve olay, tekrarlanan ziyaret ilişkisi üzerinden adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar hasta ziyaretini ortak çekirdek olarak verir ve aynı dönüşlü ziyaret fikrini felaket ya da yas sebebiyle insanların uğradığı eve ve olaya genişletir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hasta ziyaretini ve insanların felaket ya da yas dolayısıyla bir haneye gidip gelmesini birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: İki özel ziyaret alanını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hastanın yanına gidip onu görme bağlamındaki temel kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hastayı ziyaret etme çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Felaket veya yas dolayısıyla yapılan ziyaret uzantısını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsanların bir felaket veya yas sebebiyle aynı haneye uğraması bağlamıyla sınırlıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Acı olay çevresindeki tekrarlı ziyaret ilişkisini korur.
error_profile.loses: Hasta ziyaretini ve hasta ziyaretçilerini dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir kişiye geri dönen iyilik, bağış, şefkat, yarar veya kolaylığı çekirdek yapar; ayrıca bir iyiliğin ardından daha fazlasını sunma ve bir seçeneğin daha yararlı olması kullanımlarını destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal fiziksel dönüşü değil, bir yarar veya iyiliğin alıcıya ulaşmasını ve onun lehine sonuç doğurmasını anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yarar ve iyilik adını korur; karşılaştırmalı yararlılık ile iyiliği artırma söyleyişlerini ayrı sözlüksel uzantılar olarak gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimseye iyilik, bağış, şefkat, yarar veya kolaylık olarak ulaşan ve onun lehine sonuç veren şey; türemiş yapılarda daha yararlı olma ya da yapılan iyiliği artırma anlamıdır.

facets.statement: Bir kişiye ulaşan iyilik, bağış, şefkat veya yarar temel anlamı oluşturur.
Bir seçeneğin kişi için başka bir seçenekten daha yararlı veya daha elverişli olması karşılaştırmalı uzantıdır.
Bir kimsenin yaptığı iyiliğin ardından daha fazlasını sunması art arda iyilik bildiren özel kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar alıcıya ulaşan yarar, bağış, şefkat ve kolaylığı ortaklaştırır; daha yararlı olma ile iyiliği artırma bu sonuç ilişkisinin özel kullanımlarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yarar, bağış, şefkat ve kolaylığın alıcı lehine sonuçlanmasını birlikte anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Yararın kişiye ulaşması ve iyilik niteliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin lehine ulaşan bağış, yardım, şefkat veya faydayı adlandırmaya uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Alıcıya ulaşan yarar ve iyilik çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki seçenekten birinin kişi için daha faydalı veya daha kolay olduğunu söyleyen karşılaştırmalı yapıda kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Bağış ve şefkat niteliğindeki iyilik adını dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, tekrar gelen her durumu temel alarak düzenli dönen toplanma veya sevinç gününü ve kişiye yeniden gelen kaygı, sevgi ya da başka hâlleri aynı sözlüksel alanda toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca takvimsel kutlamayı değil, tekrar tekrar gelen ruhsal veya yaşantısal hâli de kapsar; kişisel alışkanlık anlamına genişlemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın birimin hem tekrarlanan özel gün hem de kişiye yeniden gelen hâl olarak doğrulanan iki kullanımını korur.

concept_map.definition: Belirli aralıklarla yeniden gelen toplanma veya sevinç günü; ayrıca kişiye tekrar tekrar dönen kaygı, sevgi ya da başka bir durumdur.

facets.statement: Bir günün veya hâlin belirli aralıklarla yeniden gelmesi ortak anlamsal çekirdektir.
Toplanma ya da sevinç için düzenli olarak geri gelen özel gün, çekirdeğin toplumsal gerçekleşmesidir.
Kaygı, sevgi, hayal veya başka bir hâlin kişiye yeniden gelmesi bireysel uzantıdır.
Bu özel güne katılmak veya onu yaşamak türemiş eylemle anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar düzenli geri gelişi ortak eksen sayar; bu eksen hem toplumsal toplanma ve sevinç gününü hem de kişiye yeniden gelen ruhsal hâlleri açıklar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yaşlı ve gücünden bir miktar kalmış deveyi merkezleştirir; bazı aktarımlar dişi koyunu da kapsar ve yaşlanma eylemini insana genişletir. Geçici açıklamadaki at kapsamı kaynak ifadesinde desteklenmediğinden tanımdan çıkarılmıştır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Temel gönderge yaşlı devedir; koyun kapsamı aktarıma bağlıdır, insanda ise ad değil yaşlanma eylemi ve deneyimli yaşlıya dayanan bir söyleyiş vardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım hayvan adı çekirdeğini, dişi biçimleri, yaşlanma eylemini ve deneyimli yaşlıdan yararlanma söyleyişini ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: İleri yaşa gelmiş fakat gücünden bir miktar kalmış deve; bazı aktarımlarda dişi koyunu da kapsar. Türemiş biçim yaşlanmayı, kalıplaşmış söyleyiş ise deneyimli yaşlılardan yardım almayı anlatır.

facets.statement: İleri yaşa gelmiş ve hâlâ bir miktar gücü bulunan deve temel göndergedir.
Hayvan adının yalnız deveye mi yoksa koyuna da mı uygulandığı konusunda kapsam aktarımı değişir.
Türemiş eylem bir hayvanın veya insanın ileri yaşa ulaşmasını anlatır.
Savaşta yaş ve bilgi sahibi kişilerden yardım isteme söyleyişi, deneyim niteliğine dayanan bir kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek yaşlı ve bir miktar gücü kalmış devedir; hayvan adının koyuna uzanıp uzanmadığı değişirken, yaşlanma eylemi insana da uygulanır ve deneyimli yaşlıdan yararlanma söyleyişi ayrıca verilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın ortak ve en dar güvenilir hayvan göndergesini, ileri yaş ile kalan gücü birlikte belirterek karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yaşlı deve ve kalan güç özelliklerini birlikte korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ince ya da genel bir tahta parçasını temel alır ve aynı sözcüğün tütsüde kullanılan kokulu odun ile çalınan telli çalgı için özelleştiğini açıkça belirtir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal geri dönüş, yaşlı deve veya eski yol anlamına girmez; maddi tahta parçası ile ondan adlandırılan tütsü ve çalgı kullanımlarıyla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın tahta parçası anlamını korur; tütsülük odun ve çalgı anlamlarını yalnız kendi tamlama ve sözlüksel uzmanlaşmalarında tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir tahta parçası veya ince dal; özel kullanımlarda yakılarak kokusundan yararlanılan odun ya da çalınan telli bir müzik aletidir.

facets.statement: Tahta parçası, ince dal veya odunsu malzeme temel maddi göndergedir.

Çalınan telli müzik aleti aynı maddi addan gelişmiş ayrı bir sözlüksel uzmanlaşmadır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar tahta parçasını temel anlam olarak ortaklaştırır ve sözcüğün hem yakılan kokulu odun hem de çalınan telli müzik aleti için özelleştiğini belirtir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli bir aile hukuku söyleyişindeki geri dönüşü verir, ancak bunun önceki sözü tekrarlama, eşle cinsel birliktelik, evliliği sürdürme veya kaçınılacağı belirtilen eylemi yapma olarak yorumlandığını aktarır. facets.statement: Özel aile hukuku söyleyişinde, daha önce söylenen sözle bağlantılı bir davranışa yeniden yönelme ortak çekirdektir.
Dönüş, aynı sözü ikinci kez söyleme olarak yorumlanabilir.
Dönüş, eşle cinsel birliktelik veya evlilik bağını sürdürme olarak yorumlanabilir.
Dönüş, kişinin yapmayacağını belirttiği eylemi sonradan gerçekleştirmesi olarak yorumlanabilir.

facets.statement: Eski bir kavmin özel adı, kendi başına ayrı bir gönderge oluşturur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli zaman veya dönem ile bilinen aralıklarda geri gelme anlamlarını destekler; zehir ağrısının yeniden alevlenmesi bu çekirdeğin belirgin gerçekleşmesidir. Bununla birlikte yayın sesi veya aralıklı titreşimi ve dağıtım ya da toplanma günü, genel zaman çekirdeğiyle eşitlenmemesi gereken kalıba bağlı ilişkili kullanımlardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek belirli zaman ve düzenli geri geliştir; yay ve özel gün kullanımları yalnızca kendi kalıplarında ilişkili anlamlar olarak tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım zaman ve aralıklı geri geliş çekirdeğini ayırır; yay sesi, aylık buluşma ve özel gün anlamlarını kendi kalıplarının dışına genellemez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin belirli zamanı veya dönemi ile belli aralıklarda yeniden ortaya çıkmasıdır. Zehir ağrısının alevlenmesi bunun özel gerçekleşmesiyken yayın sesi ve titreşimi ile dağıtım ya da toplanma günü kalıba bağlı ilişkili kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin belirlenmiş zamanı, dönemi veya en güçlü evresi.

Yayın aralıklı titreşimini veya bu titreşimden çıkan sesi adlandırma.
Dağıtım, yoklama veya geçici toplanma için belirlenmiş günü adlandırma.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu tanıklık, belirli zaman ve belli aralıklarla geri gelme çekirdeğini; ağrının yeniden alevlenmesi, dönemin en güçlü evresi, yayın tekrarlı hareketi veya sesi ve özel bir gün gibi kullanımlarla gösterir.

Geçici çerçeve, sayma fikrinin bu dalda yalın miktar belirleme değil katılımcılar arasındaki pay ve karşılıklılık ilişkisini kurduğunu doğru biçimde yansıtır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, ortak çekirdeği bir varlığı harekete geçirip göndermek ya da elde tutmayı bırakıp salmak olarak kurar. İnsan, elçi, rüzgar, yağmur ve başka güçler bu işlemin farklı nesneleridir; bunlar ayrı birer çekirdek anlam değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, gönderme ve serbest bırakmayı kapsar; yalnızca yavaşlık, süt veya sürü bildiren eşsesli kullanımları kapsamaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanı, canlıyı, doğal gücü ya da başka bir şeyi bulunduğu yerden harekete geçirip bir yöne göndermek; kimi bağlamlarda elde tutmayı bırakıp serbestçe gitmesine izin vermektir.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, bir varlığı durduğu veya tutulduğu konumdan çıkarıp ileri yöneltmektir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözcüğü süt için kullanır, bol ve art arda meme akışını bu adlandırmanın gerekçesi olarak verir ve bir topluluğun hayvanlarından süt elde etmesini aynı dala bağlar. Çerçeve madde, akış ve elde edilebilirlik ayrımlarını korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir kullanımda sıkıntının karşıtı olan rahatlığı, başka bir kullanımda ise bir şeyi içten ve isteyerek vermeyi gösterir. Çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak gönüllü veriş rahatlık çekirdeğinin bağımsız eş anlamlısı değil, belirli verme bağlamındaki uzantısı olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız verilen yapılarda rahatlık ve gönül hoşluğuyla vermeyi kapsar; genel süt, sürü veya bütün refah adlandırmalarına genişletilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız sıkıntı-rahatlık karşıtlığını ve gönül hoşluğuyla verme kullanımını taşıyan belirtilmiş yapıya bağlıdır; yalın bir kök anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli söz yapılarında sıkıntı ve sertliğin karşıtı olan rahatlık ile bir şeyi zorlanmadan, gönül hoşluğuyla verme durumunu anlatır.

facets.statement: Temel karşıtlık, sıkıntılı ve sert durum karşısındaki rahatlık ve ferahlıktır.
Verme bağlamında rahatlık, isteksizlik veya zorlama olmadan gönülden vermek olarak gerçekleşir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak malzemesi rahatlığı sıkıntının karşısına koyar; verme bağlamında bu rahatlık, kişinin içinden gelerek ve isteyerek vermesi biçiminde açıklanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Verilen yapıdaki durum karşıtlığını ve verme bağlamındaki özel uzantıyı birlikte gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Sıkıntının karşıtı rahatlığı ve isteyerek verme uzantısını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sıkıntılı dönem ile rahat dönem karşı karşıya getirildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sıkıntının karşıtı olan rahat durum yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Gönül hoşluğuyla verme uzantısını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin zorlanmadan ve içtenlikle verildiği bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Verişte isteklilik ve iç rahatlığını korur.
error_profile.loses: Sıkıntının karşıtı genel rahatlık durumunu kapsamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Bu dal, kanıtta tek üretken kök çekirdeğine indirgenmeyen sınırlı adlandırma malzemesini taşır. Yapısal bölme şartı koşmadan, yalnız verilen biçim ve bağlam sınırı içinde kontrollü adlandırma kümesi olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kayıt genel kök anlamı gibi genişletilmemeli, içindeki öğeler birbirinin yerine geçen tek bir sözlük karşılığı sayılmamalı ve yalnız kanıtın verdiği adlandırma sınırı içinde kullanılmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kapsam verilen biçim, adlandırma veya özel kullanım sınırıyla bağlıdır; ortak bir yalın anlam ya da üretken genel kullanım varsayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bu dal ortak bir anlam çekirdeği göstermeyen altı ayrı adlandırmayı bir arada tutmaktadır; kısa ok, iki damar, damızlık erkek deve, aktarım zinciri kopuk söz, boncuklu kolye ve başını örtmeyen küçük kız ayrı ayrı ele alınmalıdır.

facets.statement: Dalın tek ortak özelliği, ortak anlamı bulunmayan özel adlandırmaların geçici olarak aynı yapısal kapta toplanmış olmasıdır.
Bir kullanım birlikte anılan iki damarı adlandırır.

Bir kullanım henüz başını örtmeyen küçük kızı niteler.
Bir kullanım kısa bir ok türünü adlandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, tek bir birleşik anlamdan çok sınırlı veya biçime bağlı adlandırmaları gösterir; dal bu kayıtları kontrollü biçimde görünür tutar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bu karşılık, kanıttaki sınırlı veya biçime bağlı adlandırma kümesini güvenli biçimde etiketler; tek ve birleşik bir sözlük anlamı değildir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Dalın bedene canlılık veren iç varlık çerçevesi kaynak ifadesinin ana eksenini karşılar. Ancak kaynaklar bu varlığı kişinin özüyle özdeş sayma ya da ondan ayrı görme konusunda ayrıldığı için tanım bu görüş ayrılığını açıkça korumalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal insan bedeninin yaşam ilkesidir; kutsal varlık adları, yel, koku ve dinlenme anlamları kapsam dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak biçim insan bedenine canlılık veren iç varlığı anlatır; başka dallardaki kalıplaşmış kullanımlar bu tanıma taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: İnsan bedenini canlı tutan ve bedenden ayrılması yaşamın bitmesi sayılan iç varlıktır. Kaynakların bir bölümü bunu kişinin özüyle aynı, bir bölümü ise ondan ayrı kabul eder.

facets.statement: İç varlık bedene canlılık verir ve onun ayrılması beden yaşamının sona ermesini bildirir.
Bu iç varlığın kişinin özüyle aynı mı yoksa ondan ayrı mı olduğu konusunda iki görüş vardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bedeni canlı tutan ve ölümde bedenden ayrılan bir iç varlıkta birleşir; bunun kişinin özüyle ilişkisini ise iki farklı biçimde açıklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsan bedenindeki yaşam ilkesini ve onun bedenden ayrılışını birlikte anlatan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Bedene canlılık verme, iç varlık olma ve ölümde ayrılma özelliklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İç varlığın bedenden ayrılmasıyla kişinin öldüğünü bildiren bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: İç varlığın niteliğini ve kişinin özüyle ilişkisine dair görüş ayrılığını vermez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Dal çerçevesi, aynı adın vahyi taşıyan göksel elçi, tek başına duran bir göksel varlık, kutsal bildiri ve benzeri kutsal varlıklar için kullanılmasını kaynak ifadesine uygun biçimde toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal kutsal ve göksel adlandırmalarla sınırlıdır; insan bedeninin yaşam ilkesi bu dalın anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak biçimin kutsal bildiri ve göksel varlık alanındaki kullanımı tanımlanır; insandaki yaşam ilkesiyle birleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Vahyi taşıyan göksel elçi, tekil bir göksel varlık, kutsal bildiri ya da kutsallıkla ilişkilendirilen bazı varlıklar için kullanılan addır.
